summary: Most requested frontend/admin features appear implemented (pathname-based /admin navigation, AdMob form init via useEffect + save toast, logo upload + header display, migration stub adding logo). However, the diff evidence does not show the required backend admin-only user overview API implementation that the frontend now calls.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes an admin-only method to fetch an overview of known users including: principal, optional profile (name), and whether a session exists (and expiry if available).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend adds a hook that calls `actor.getUserOverview()` and Admin Panel expects overview data, but the backend diff snippet does not show any `getUserOverview` (or equivalent) method being implemented/exposed, nor its admin-only authorization behavior.
